summary: newcleo plc, f/k/a NewCleo Ltd., furnished a 6-K reporting consummation of its business combination with NewHold Investment Corp III, a Cayman SPAC. The de-SPAC closed September 21, 2026; ordinary shares and public warrants began trading on Nasdaq under NWCL and NWCLW on September 22, 2026. The filing discloses post-closing board and executive officers led by CEO Stefano Buono, plus amended articles, a warrant termination/assignment/assumption agreement naming Computershare as successor warrant agent, and an amended registration rights agreement. Terms such as price, stake, and premium were not restated. Arbitrage angle: watch warrant terms, lock-up/registration overhang, and early trading liquidity.
